shopify.name: Shopify
shopify.tagline: Auto-import your Shopify orders as pending orders in Closwiz.
shopify.confirmDisconnectBody: Closwiz will stop importing orders and your stored credentials will be deleted. You can reconnect anytime.
shopify.missingFields: Domain, access token and API secret are all required
shopify.webhookPublicHint: Set PUBLIC_BASE_URL to a public https URL (or run a tunnel) so Closwiz can register the orders webhook automatically.
shopify.howTitle: How to connect your Shopify store
shopify.howStep1: In Shopify admin, open Settings → Apps and sales channels → Develop apps.
shopify.howStep2: Click "Create an app", name it "Closwiz", then open Configuration → Admin API integration.
shopify.howStep3: Grant the read_orders scope and save.
shopify.howStep4: Install the app, then copy the Admin API access token (shown once) and the API secret key.
shopify.howStep5: Paste the store domain, token and secret here, then click Connect.
shopify.behaviorBody: Every new Shopify order is imported into your Orders page as a pending order (and pushed to your Google Sheet if configured). No WhatsApp message is sent automatically — you stay in control.

botFunnel.title: Bot Funnel
botFunnel.subtitle: Products, orders, conversations, and bot settings — all wired to the paired WhatsApp session.

ecommerce.title: E-commerce COD
ecommerce.subtitle: Physical products sold cash-on-delivery — the bot detects the product, collects name, city, address and quantity, then closes the order.
ecommerce.explainer: The bot detects which product a customer wants from their first message using the product name + aliases. Set the description with full bot context (pack prices, benefits) — the bot reads it when answering.
ecommerce.empty: No products yet. Click “New product” to add your first physical item.

services.title: Services & Bookings
services.subtitle: Bookable services & reservations — the bot collects the details you define, then confirms the booking. No stock, no packs.
services.explainer: The bot detects which service a customer wants from their first message using its name + aliases, collects the custom fields you define below, then confirms the booking.
services.empty: No services yet. Click “New service” to add a bookable offering (rental, appointment, reservation…).

products.explainer: The bot detects which product a customer wants from their first message using the product name + aliases. Set the description with full bot context (Pack prices, benefits) — the bot reads it when answering.
products.newProductTooltip: Physical product — bot collects name, city, address, quantity, then closes the order.
products.newServiceTooltip: Service / booking — bot collects name, service date, city, address, notes, then confirms the booking.
products.emptyHint: Click New product for a physical item or New service for a booking-style offering (rental car, haircut, plumbing, catering, etc.).

drawer.kindHint: Physical product → bot asks name/city/address/quantity then closes the order. Service / booking → bot asks name/date/city/address/notes then confirms the appointment. (No quantity for services — every booking is one entry.)
drawer.statusOutOfStock: Out of stock — acknowledge but don't close
drawer.statusFullyBooked: Fully booked — acknowledge but don't close
drawer.whatsappHint: Pick at least one of YOUR linked numbers — the bot replies about THIS product on the number(s) you tick. A keyword in the customer's message can still route to another product.
drawer.whatsappRequiredError: Select at least one WhatsApp number for this product.
drawer.descHintProduct: Full text the bot reads when answering. Include pack prices like “Pack 1 bouteille : 299 000 GNF” — the brain auto-parses them into tiers.
drawer.descHintService: Full text the bot reads when answering. Describe the service, what's included, the price and availability — the bot uses this to answer questions before confirming a booking.
drawer.secIdentitySub: How the bot recognizes this on the first message.
drawer.aliasesHint: Keywords / synonyms / misspellings the bot recognizes: biorein, bio rein, bio-rein…
drawer.secDescriptionSub: The text the bot reads when answering questions.
drawer.secPhotosSub: The main card image plus extra photos the bot can send.
drawer.photoHint: Main image shown on the card. Drag a PNG/JPG/WEBP or click to pick one.
drawer.galleryHint: Extra photos the bot sends right after detecting this (angles, benefits, testimonials). Up to 5, sent one by one.
drawer.secAvailabilitySub: When the bot offers it, which numbers reply, and where orders go.
drawer.sheetsHint: Confirmed orders for this item POST here. Overrides the seller-wide webhook in Settings.
drawer.secPriceSub: Shown to the customer and used in the order recap.

customFields.sectionHint: Tell the bot exactly what to gather from the customer before confirming a booking. Toggle the built-in fields and add your own (e.g. "Reservation date", "Number of guests", "Car type"). Leave everything empty to keep the default service flow (name → date → city → address → notes).
customFields.phoneNote: The bot reads the phone number automatically from WhatsApp — it never asks the customer for it.
customFields.empty: No fields yet — add what the bot should collect for this service.

settings.businessTypeHint: Tailors the whole dashboard (titles, columns, wording) and how the bot collects info from customers.
settings.toneHint: How the bot sounds when it chats with customers.
